costs_rule: the marginal cost is $0 (no new pass: the attributes unit's existing rows); the full charge is the attributes unit's own recorded costs; both are reported (LW-18)
name: score_selfinf_n
requirement: REQ-13 (brief rev 1); LW-18 (built before wave 1); ADD-6.6; ADD-8.2 (it counts toward the plant's finds a known cause; a recorded switch in REQ-29 drops it if REQ-13 misses W1)
rule: per training row at checkpoint q: grad_norm must be equal in the harmful and the safe set's records (else the code refuses); SI = grad_norm^2; len = the response tokens without the end-of-turn token (P's target tokens - 1); score = ln(SI + 1) + ln(len + 1); the top 600 (scored only) is write_score_edit.py's (scorer selfinf_n)

sensitivities.e1: the same score at checkpoint e1 (report only)
sensitivities.q_plus_e1: SI = the sum over q and e1 of grad_norm^2 (report only)

unit: the wave-0b attributes unit that T1's A1 contract reads, checked and read only through write_score_edit.check_attributes_unit (its pins are write_score_edit.json's a1.attributes_unit)
